headline: Check the recipient before you send
subtext: The public directory lets sources review verified Hush Line profiles and choose the person or team they mean to contact before sending a message.
image_alt_text: A dark-mode desktop social graphic showing the Hush Line public directory with verified recipient profile cards, a search field, and category filters for people looking for a trusted contact.

social.bluesky:
Before sharing a sensitive tip, confirm that the line belongs to the person or team you meant to reach.

Hush Line's public directory lets sources review verified profiles and start first contact in the browser.

Learn more at https://hushline.app.
social.linkedin:
Before sharing a sensitive tip, it helps to confirm that the line belongs to the person or team you meant to reach.

Hush Line's public directory gives sources a browser-based way to review verified profiles for journalists, lawyers, educators, organizers, developers, and other trusted recipients. You can start first contact without creating an account or installing an app.

Learn more at https://hushline.app.

rationale: The shortlist contained one eligible screenshot, a public verified directory view. Although directory posts appeared in the prior 31 days, this plan uses the available candidate and shifts the message away from attorney filtering and recipient onboarding toward a source-side check before first contact, grounded in the documented need for message senders to find a trustworthy recipient without creating an account.
copy_brief: Write for sources and public users evaluating or using Hush Line.
title: Directory - Verified
